title: Auronzo di Cadore Catalog V2 Fact Enrichment
summary: Reviews Monte Agudo and Auronzo di Cadore source-aware facts against official municipal tourism and operator sources. The supported town character is added while unsupported ski-area facilities remain explicitly unknown.

before: Modeled as a separate destination from Misurina because Auronzo has its own stay context, Monte Agudo ski access, town/value recommendation profile, and official destination treatment.
Monte Agudo terrain metrics use child-scope reviewed ski-area data that matches the detailed official lift/slope table; broader official narrative says nearly 20 km and remains a scope caveat.
Auronzo/Misurina shared ski-school/operator/pass wording is preserved as linked pass and source context, not used to merge the destinations.
Lodging and rental price ranges, stay-base quality tier, and rental quality tier remain product-curated estimates pending a dedicated sampling policy.

evidence.source_title: Municipality of Auronzo official skiing guide

evidence.normalization_note: The explicit low-crowd and tranquil positioning is mapped to quiet.

unresolved_caveats: The reviewed Monte Agudo sources do not publish child-scoped snowmaking, glacier, snow-park, night-skiing, marked-freeride, or ski-day-apres facts.
The available official piste documents combine Cortina, San Vito, Auronzo, and Misurina, so no child-specific Monte Agudo trail-map URL is recorded.
Official sources describe low-key post-ski activities but do not establish a dedicated local apres inventory for Auronzo.
